findings.title: The approved scope-addendum authority becomes unusable after the lawful B02 submission transition
findings.reproduction: At exact frozen REVIEW state 962f92ff831c9a3d87a7d6ba796c8194e70b6c2c, run `.venv\Scripts\python.exe tools\recoveryctl.py --repo . supplement-status GRR-0002.S02` and `.venv\Scripts\python.exe tools\recoveryctl.py --repo . supplement-validate GRR-0002.S02`; both exit nonzero with `B02 scope-addendum base authority, candidates, backlog, or witness differs`. The only candidate-to-reviewed-state backlog delta is the lawful GRR-0002.B02 IN_PROGRESS-to-REVIEW transition with exact candidate d363c04c385251a5d789a0313e173342e7e0ae3e, evidence SHA-256 77cdc545de58ef9d7237a8ba1c32969a449a87216479fd104e5649e6b5958595, and R01 current submission. In tools/recoveryctl.py, approved_b02_scope_addendum_paths authenticates the installed-candidate backlog blob but then also requires that blob to equal the current working backlog after CRLF normalization and requires the current raw SHA-256 to equal the pre-submit installed backlog hash. Those conditions necessarily become false after supplement-submit. A bounded replay of the three B02 addendum tests at the frozen state produces one error and five failures/subtest failures: the valid strict-descendant case reaches this same authority error, while the remaining fixtures copy the REVIEW backlog over an older commit and become dirty before their checkout. This contradicts acceptance criterion 6's frozen-submission and independent-review lifecycle, acceptance criterion 8's focused real-Git lifecycle coverage, and required outcome 4; the controller cannot validate or independently review the exact state it just lawfully created.

At minimum, accept only authenticated IN_PROGRESS, exact frozen REVIEW submission, append-only adverse-review/resubmission, and eventual exact approved projections as appropriate to the invoked transition, while continuing to require control/minimum revision 11, the sole ACTIVE HOLD-W1-GRR-0002, W1 PAUSED at wave scope, absent W1.A04, BLOCKED CAP-02.S04.T03, PENDING G1, exact S02/addendum authority and ancestry, and the exact witness-only workspace. Fixtures must derive packet-time backlog proof from the installed Git blob rather than copying the mutable REVIEW backlog over older commits.
